item: the instant title rung: a titles-only prefix index and an omnibar row answered from the first character
summary: A small contentless FTS5 table over article titles (prefix 1-4, newest-ingested first, stop at the first hits) answers every keystroke of the omnibar from the first character; measured on a 1 M-article SQLCipher store with the real schema: p99 13 ms overall and under 3.3 ms for 1-4 characters, against seconds for the ranked path. History is filled by a bounded, resumable background job (never at boot) and the surface says how much of the corpus the index covers. Frequent-word 5+ character prefixes cost ~20 ms and grow with the corpus (time-sharding is the 5 TB answer, not built). Not relevance: the header says so x12 locales. A backup merge suspends the title trigger (live cost +50% on 100k+100k; deferred merge 16.5 s vs 20.7 s live, backfill after 1.7 s per 100k titles) and marks the index behind in its own transaction; after the boot steps the budgeted background job is queued (OO_TITLE_INDEX_AUTOBUILD=0 off).
